sources.note: Detects flawed reasoning from residual-stream trajectories by combining layerwise motion with a quantized region reader and a normalized direction reader, rather than probing full states.
sources.title: Reasoning Errors Have a Region and a Direction in the Residual-Stream Trajectory of LLMs

sources.note: Benchmarks multimodal models on detecting and categorizing errors in K-12 math solutions collected from real student interactions, with the best model about 10% behind human experts.
sources.title: ErrorRadar: Benchmarking Complex Mathematical Reasoning of Multimodal Large Language Models Via Error Detection

result.definition: Judging whether a reasoning step or a solution is wrong, treated by the sources as a competence separable from producing correct work. They approach it from opposite sides. One reads it off internal state, detecting flawed reasoning from residual-stream trajectory motion combined with restricted region and direction information, and improving selection accuracy by up to 12% over displacement-only methods on unseen benchmarks. The other makes it the task itself, benchmarking error step identification and categorization on 2,500 multimodal K-12 problems drawn from real student interactions, where the best model sits about 10% behind expert human evaluators. Between them the archive gets both a cheap internal signal and an external reference for what it should be measured against.
